project.name: Monolith Queue
project.description: A durable, ordered, at-least-once message queue in the same Postgres as your data, so enqueuing composes atomically with your transactions. The one primitive under the transactional outbox and durable job patterns: per-key ordering, SKIP LOCKED claiming, retries with backoff, dead-lettering, and LISTEN/NOTIFY dispatch. See docs/design/QUEUE.md.
